HIGH_CONFIDENCE.definition: Strong statistical evidence with fully compatible model features, validated causal history, and multi-indicator corroboration.

MEDIUM_CONFIDENCE.definition: Moderate anomaly score or single-model threat detection with partial feature compatibility or limited corroboration.

LOW_CONFIDENCE.definition: Weak anomaly score exceeding 5% baseline threshold, uncalibrated out-of-sample anomaly indicator, or uncorroborated single flow outlier.

warmup_policy.insufficient_history_action: Suppress aggressive classification; mark detector status as INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY.

critical_threshold_metadata.source: Random Forest predict_proba on CIC-IDS2017 Friday DDoS
critical_threshold_metadata.reason: Probabilities >= 0.90 represent extreme volumetric confidence under supervised Random Forest model.
critical_threshold_metadata.model_calibration_basis: Empirical decision boundary on 74 CIC-IDS2017 training features.

high_threshold_metadata.reason: Standard majority voting threshold across Random Forest estimators.
high_threshold_metadata.model_calibration_basis: Supervised training split on historical dataset.

medium_threshold_metadata.reason: Captures sub-threshold volumetric growth before flooding saturates target.
medium_threshold_metadata.model_calibration_basis: Prototype triage threshold only; not statistically calibrated for standalone alerting.

recommended_actions: Monitor volumetric source packet and byte rates
Correlate with destination server CPU/network load metrics
Review ingress traffic patterns across border routers

decision_threshold_metadata.source: CTU-13 Scenario 42 Normal Training Baseline (95th percentile Hybrid Score)
decision_threshold_metadata.reason: Guarantees 5% False Positive Rate on clean historical campus network traffic.
decision_threshold_metadata.model_calibration_basis: 5% FPR quantile on 21,242 clean normal training flows in PCA + DBSCAN + Beaconing space.

critical_threshold_metadata.source: Hybrid score >= 0.85 with verified repeated host causal history
critical_threshold_metadata.reason: Escalates to CRITICAL only when both geometric manifold anomaly and behavioral timing regularity are corroborated across >= 3 flows.
critical_threshold_metadata.model_calibration_basis: Prototype triage threshold; requires multi-flow history.

high_threshold_metadata.reason: Flags noticeable departure from normal baseline PCA reconstruction subspace.
high_threshold_metadata.model_calibration_basis: Continuous distance metric normalized against 2x calibration threshold.

medium_threshold_metadata.reason: Provides low-severity analyst visibility into subtle timing irregularities.

recommended_actions: Review historical connection regularity and inter-arrival times
Correlate destination IP with external threat intelligence feeds
Inspect DNS resolution history for destination domain

anomaly_score_threshold_metadata.source: CIC-IDS2017 Tuesday Normal Training Baseline (95th percentile negative decision_function)
anomaly_score_threshold_metadata.reason: Calibrated 5% FPR boundary for single-flow Isolation Forest on normal enterprise traffic.
anomaly_score_threshold_metadata.model_calibration_basis: Empirical quantile of Isolation Forest decision scores on 301,319 clean normal training flows.

high_threshold_metadata.reason: Severe statistical isolation from normal baseline flow distributions.
high_threshold_metadata.model_calibration_basis: Prototype triage threshold only; requires host fan-out corroboration to confirm port scanning.

recommended_actions: Review source IP connection attempts across destination ports
Correlate with subnet firewall connection rejection logs
Monitor source host for subsequent lateral movement
Inspect domain character entropy and DNS query volume
Inspect TLS handshake SNI and cipher suite metadata
Analyze sustained outbound byte volumes and ratio imbalances
